footer: Compiled from wire reports published on 17 November 2026. One day, seven stories.

lead.headline: Ukraine strikes the Kerch Bridge again
lead.summary: Kyiv says the road span to Crimea is badly damaged and traffic is halted; Russia hits bridges near Kyiv in reply.

stories.headline: Tankers mined in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: A fourth tanker is hit in a day; the US strikes Qeshm.

stories.headline: Japan scrambles jets as Russian planes enter its airspace
stories.summary: Tokyo protests after two Russian aircraft cross into its skies.

stories.headline: West urges Israel to open Gaza aid crossings
stories.summary: Britain, Australia, Canada and Italy call it catastrophic.

stories.headline: Markets slide before Nvidia earnings
stories.summary: Stocks fall; Bitcoin slips below $65,000 before Nvidia results.
